risk: Held-out response labels enter DEBIAS-M correction or prediction loss.
control: Never pass target labels to correction, tuning, early stopping or model fitting.
verification: Script separates y_test and references it only after final probabilities are written.

risk: Target AUC is used to select batch_str, learning rate, epochs, feature cap, mode or downstream model.
control: Freeze official/default correction settings and five seeds before opening target labels.
verification: No performance-driven selection; report all prespecified modes and seeds.

risk: Standard DEBIAS-M is described as fully inductive although x_val target abundances enter fitting.
control: Label explicitly as transductive unsupervised target-distribution adaptation.
verification: Estimand wording checked in Results, Methods, legends and cover letter.

risk: Online DEBIAS-M is described as static single-patient prediction.
control: State that unseen target-batch factors are estimated from an unlabeled target sample set.

risk: Prevalence filtering, variance ranking, pseudocount or scaling uses held-out target data.
control: Select features using outer-training samples only; pass raw nonnegative abundances for selected taxa to DEBIAS-M.
verification: Fold audit stores feature list and training-only transformation state.

risk: Clinical domain, publication family or processing batch is chosen after observing performance.
is_label_leakage: Yes if chosen by target performance
control: Prespecify clinical domain as the primary batch variable.
verification: Batch map and checksum frozen before execution.

risk: Clinical-domain correction is interpreted as isolated laboratory processing-bias correction.
control: Call it domain adaptation; acknowledge confounding by geography, host, treatment, endpoint and technical factors.
verification: No causal attribution to processing protocol.

risk: DEBIAS-M embedded classifier is compared directly with the frozen class-balanced elastic-net as if only correction differed.
control: Primary benchmark uses DEBIAS-M as preprocessing followed by the same locked downstream elastic-net.
verification: Embedded classifier is tertiary and separately labelled.

risk: Official wrapper accepts sample_weight but the inspected fit path does not use it; correction's phenotype loss is unweighted.
control: Retain class-balanced downstream elastic-net and disclose that embedded DEBIAS-M correction uses its official unweighted phenotype objective.
verification: No claim of exact classifier equivalence.

risk: random_state is stored by the wrapper but is not passed to the inspected training function.
control: Set NumPy, Python, PyTorch and Lightning seeds externally; run five prespecified seeds.
verification: Seed-level metrics and deterministic smoke-test logs retained.

risk: Official training uses a sample-level internal validation split for early stopping rather than grouped domains.
control: Do not use internal validation performance for scientific inference; keep official algorithm unchanged and assess outer held-out domains only.
verification: Outer-fold target remains untouched by labels.

risk: Best seed, best fold or best DEBIAS-M mode is selectively reported.
control: Report all prespecified seeds, both adaptation modes and all LODO/LOSFO folds.
verification: No model promotion; baseline remains primary.
